author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Today a chat report.

Name of player being reported: Universee
Rule broken: Disrespect and more (your judgement)
Evidence: https://i.gyazo.com/280bf7535835255e535a61a14ed16949.png http://pastebin.com/PKuJ8UVE
Anything else you would like to add? I was afk for a few minutes, when I came back, I checked the chat and saw a guy with a spambot who was ban evading. (He's banned now) He spammed a certain message. Another player, who apparently wasn't ban evading repeated the message too, but only once. I then checked my chat logs if the player was spamming too, but it turned out that he broke some other rules. You can see his messages with pressing CTRL + F and search for "Universee".

Greetings,
-Atdit
